FictionalAction: Attach an internal file directly to a shared Space page
Why: An uploaded page attachment follows the page access rules
ReaderPreflight: Remove the attachment or limit effective page access

FictionalAction: Place a link to a separately restricted document on a shared Space page
Why: Sharing a page does not itself grant access to the linked original
ReaderPreflight: Check the original file permissions separately

FictionalAction: Link to a restricted report without copying its contents
Why: A link is a pointer and does not alter source access

FictionalAction: Copy confidential lines from a restricted report into a shared page
Why: People who can read the page can read its copied text without original-file permission
ReaderPreflight: Remove sensitive copied text before sharing

FictionalAction: Move a private draft below a page shared with a team
Why: The new parent can grant access to a moved page
ReaderPreflight: Review permissions of the new parent and space

FictionalAction: Remove a direct page invitation while the same reader retains parent access
Why: Removing direct access does not revoke an independent inherited grant
ReaderPreflight: Change the parent or space grant where necessary
